_about: Waivers cover files that CANNOT carry an inline allowance - JSON, binaries, generated artifacts. Committed on purpose: a hidden waiver is a disabled rule.

waivers.reason: machine-readable finding register contributed by another agent; it quotes the defective patterns and on-chain payloads it documents. JSON cannot carry a comment, so the allowance lives here instead.
captured live mainnet account history used as a test fixture; it contains real on-chain custom_json payloads including required_auths. Fixtures must stay faithful to the chain.
cross-language validation vectors; they quote real mainnet calldata by design.
